_help: Planning gate: fill this BEFORE painting, check it against the skill checklists, generate prompt_text with tools/build_prompt.py manifest.json --write (it fills builder reference/prompt-template.md from these fields), then paint. precheck.py --manifest FAILS a manifest missing scene_situation, interactions, siblings, used_motifs or prompt_text. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
setting: School canteen at lunch: long tables, a rug, a serving counter at the back.
theme_fit: Every word below is something a person does or meets in this place (placement by gloss, not by the English word).

prompt._rule: facts tools/build_prompt.py puts into the template; kind is room, zoom or sprite
prompt.materials: cream plaster walls, oak floorboards, red tiled roof seen through the windows
prompt.set_apart: bright midday light, red rug as the dominant colour
prompt.landmark: the long serving counter with a steaming soup pot
prompt.whimsy: a hatch to the kitchen shaped like a big smiling mouth
prompt.beyond: the garden beds through the blue door; the village path off the left edge
prompt.differ: low camera at child height, lunch queue as the focal action, midday light

scene_situation: Lunch service in the school canteen: children queue at the counter, share tables and pass dishes.

interactions.doing: two pairs share one long table; the vous pair hands bread across to the nous children
Monsieur Verbe takes his tray from the dinner lady at the counter and bites his sandwich

_interactions_rule: small groups of 2-4 doing one thing together; every word belongs to a group (precheck WARNs on a word in no group). 'background: ...' marks unlabelled scenery figures (natural-scene gate).
siblings: ecole/jardin: garden from a high angle, green, digging in beds
ecole/theatre: stage from the stalls, warm stage lights

doors.painted_as: open blue door onto the garden
clear path off the left edge

zooms._rule: no one-object zooms: a zoom with fewer than about 4 words is folded into a fuller scene

text_in_image.why: a real canteen would have this sign; it names the place, not a word being taught

items.hook: the mnemonic sentence the card will show, verbatim
items.shown: two children sharing one big bowl of soup with two straws
items.pose_action: both sip at the same moment, heads touching
items.hook_object: two NOODLES slurped from one bowl

items.pose_action: mid-bite into a sandwich, cheeks full
items.verb_acts_on: on the sandwich at the long right table, human scale, inside the scene
items.interacts_with: the dinner lady at the counter

items._example: a sensitive word: say exactly how it is treated (plaque only / mild depiction / omitted with note)

prompt_text: Generated by tools/build_prompt.py manifest.json --write; do not type it by hand.
